units.text: The team connected the warehouse system to the ERP through API middleware, and the delay in order status shrank from overnight to 15 minutes.
I analysed truck GPS data in Excel, found that 4 morning routes overlapped and redrew them as 3, saving about 90 km of driving per day.
We introduced a min-max replenishment model in SAP, and stock-outs in the central warehouse went down by 30% over the spring.
